decisions.reason: This PETG thermoforming blank remains close to the firm's core dental laboratory materials business, and the prior dedicated launch commitment plus accumulated commercial investment make management more inclined to continue than to reverse course.

The intraoral contrast spray fits the company's stated move toward digital dental workflows, so its strategic relevance and visible introduction support continued commitment unless unmistakable negative evidence emerges.

Although less prominently marketed, the custom earmold line uses the firm's established custom-manufacturing capabilities and hearing-care channels, which encourages retention despite somewhat higher uncertainty than for the more visibly committed dental products.
